content.comment_body: Hello, I searched previous forum posts and found a discussion from several years ago which mentioned that displaying decimal values on the [product_name] web page required manual changes in the HTML code. I am wondering if, after these years, this issue has been resolved? I still haven't found an easy method for displaying decimal values directly.
With the current [product_name] version [version_no], it is now possible to set up to three decimal places for analog values.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is checking whether decimal display for analog values on the [product_name] web page is now supported by default. The feedback confirms that newer software versions have improved usability by allowing users to set up to three decimal places natively, without code modifications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple method to show decimal values for analog data on the [product_name] web page, without needing to manually edit code.
